title: AdoTelemetryFieldConfig
description: Externalized configuration for the ADO telemetry field bootstrap preflight step. Embed the default at DBAIAzure.Core.Resources.default-telemetry-config.json; override via IConfiguration["AdoTelemetry:ConfigPath"].

work_item_types.description: Keyed by logical WIT name ("UserStory" or "Task"). Resolved to the actual ADO WIT name at runtime based on detected process type (Agile → "User Story"; Scrum → "Product Backlog Item").

fallback_strategy.description: Maps an AdoFieldType string to a fallback ADO reference name. Null value means log-only.

tags_encoding.description: Encoding scheme used when writing multiple values to the Tags fallback field.

fields.description: Ordered list of telemetry fields to create/map for this work item type.

name.description: ADO display name for the field (e.g. "AI Session ID").

reference.description: ADO reference name (e.g. "Custom.AISessionID"). Must start with "Custom." for custom fields.

picklist.description: Required when type is "picklistString". Ordered list of allowed values.

required.description: Whether the field is required on the work item. Always false for telemetry fields.

fallback_reference.description: ADO reference name of the native field to use when Bootstrap Mode is not available. Null means log-only.

fallback_display_name.description: Human-readable name of the fallback field. Used for manifest and log messages.
